_comment: Assertion inventory for check_advocacy_claims.py. Guards the reader-facing pages against (a) the appearance of figures that are not part of the case-level series of record and (b) silent drift of the required headline claims and hedges. Patterns are Python regexes; required patterns match whitespace-normalized page text, forbidden patterns match raw lines and wrap-normalized text. Any change to the series of record requires a deliberate, simultaneous update of the pages and this inventory. The retired victories-per-month presentation has no successor pattern by design.
